readMe: Specs that are RED on purpose, read by scripts/e2e-gate.mjs (roadmap T.18). This project commits a claim spec BEFORE the feature it claims, so a gate that cannot say 'red until X lands' would be switched off the first time it was inconvenient. Every entry needs a roadmap id that is still an OPEN box in ROADMAP.md, and a reason. An entry whose tests start passing turns the gate red: tick the row and delete the entry. `test` is the exact test title, or "*" for every test in the file.

expectedRed.reason: The percussion staff was built (64de051) and reverted when /improve-app run 2026-09-06-1 aborted on the BLOCKER ratchet. The spec is kept, in its strengthened form, as the proof a rebuild has to pass: 4 failed on the reverted tree, 4 passed on the implementation.
